title: Looking for space...this is the place!
description:
Property Site: https://view.paradym.com/v/5311-Sulfur-Spring-Drive-Killeen-TX-76542/4378216

5311 Sulfur Spring Drive
Killeen, TX 76542
$226,900, 4 bed, 2.50 bath, 2,765 SF, MLS# 386122

Looking for space...this is the place! The well-landscaped yard is just the start of this beautiful home! Stepping inside, you will find the formal dining to the left and to the right, the half bathroom, laundry room, and the garage entrance to the house. You will love the open floor plan from the large living room to the great kitchen! The enormous master bedroom is located on the first story with a wonderful master bathroom that features dual vanities, jetted tub, separate shower, and HUGE walk-in closet. Checking out the second story, you will see a second living/game room that includes a wet bar. All secondary bedrooms are very spacious and share the upstairs bathroom. Walking out back you will enjoy the covered patio, grassy backyard, and wood privacy fence. Schedule your appointment today!
